facts.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

setpoint.label: light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment shall be provided and maintained wherever this standard applies, and its condition shall be treated as a material unwanted event control. The light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks shall be set at 30 m. This clause applies to activities archived under MOBILE-EQUIPMENT-INTERACTION at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
